title: Courgette fritters with ham and eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Courgettes, spring onions, flour, cheddar, eggs, cherry tomatoes and cooked ham are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a sieve and a frying pan, and the fritters are simple enough for a confident beginner.

works.reason: Three squeezed courgettes bound with 75g flour, 50g cheddar and 2 eggs is a sound fritter ratio, and with four fried eggs and ham it makes a good plate for four.

honest_times.reason: Grating, squeezing, mixing and frying the fritters in batches, then the eggs, fits roughly 30 active minutes, and the 10 minute salting accounts for the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the chives, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Mid-June courgettes are the body of the fritters and the clear point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper cooked breakfast of vegetables, eggs, cheese and ham that a family would happily eat.
